text.en:
The provisions of existing laws, rules and regulations to the contrary notwithstanding, the
amount of P741,720.05, representing the total savings from the appropriations of completed bridge projects
undertaken by the Department of Public Highways, is hereby reappropriated and made available for the
construction of the Cauplasan Bridge, Km. 505.53, along Ilocos Norte-Apayao Road, Dingras, Ilocos Norte.

The Secretary of Public Highways is hereby authorized to re-program and disburse this amount
for the construction of the above-mentioned project.

This Decree shall take effect upon its approval.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 20th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
